snippet.title: Genigods Nezha Deep Dive | TGS 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the Genigods: Nezha Deep Dive from TGS 2026, featuring an in-depth look at Genigods Lab’s ambitious action RPG, its Chinese mythology-inspired world, colossal battles, combat systems, and the journey of the Spirit Pearl as Nezha.

Tokyo Game Show 2026 is here! Catch all the biggest game reveals, trailers, gameplay, demos, announcements, and surprises from TGS 2026.

Watch all of our TGS 2026 coverage here:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPZoHW-xRvGo

This Deep Dive takes a closer look at Genigods: Nezha, a hardcore action RPG rooted in ancient Chinese creation mythology. Players embody the Spirit Pearl, the first life forged by the goddess Nüwa, before being reincarnated as Nezha. The adventure features enormous gods to battle and climb, ground and aerial combat, the Fire-Tipped Spear and Wind Fire Wheels, mythic relic combinations, and a reactive combat system built around precise parries and counters.

Developed by Genigods Lab using Unreal Engine 5, Genigods: Nezha sends players on a journey to mend the shattered sky, uncover the truth behind the Spirit Pearl’s origins, and seal spacetime rifts threatening the world. The game is currently announced for PlayStation 5 and PC, with its release date still to be determined on its official store listings.
